en: Changed SDK and `claude -p` mid-turn messages to count as the user's where feature flags aren't fetched, as on clouds or with telemetry off, from Opus 4.8 on; mark relayed text `isSynthetic: true`
zh: 变更：从 Opus 4.8 起，在未获取功能标志的情况下（如云端或关闭遥测时），SDK 和 `claude -p` 的轮次中消息计为用户消息；请将转发的文本标记为 `isSynthetic: true`
